    Reference

    Lookups

    Functions for retrieving reference data from the CDE API

    get_agencies()

    Get all agencies from the CDE API

    get_offense_codes()

    Get offense codes from the CDE API

    get_states()

    Get state list from the CDE API

    get_agency_info()

    Get information about the selected agency

    Summarized Crime

    Functions for querying UCR Offenses Known and Clearances data

    get_agency_crime()

    Get agency-level crime data from the UCR Offenses Known and Clearances

    get_estimated_crime()

    Get state- or national-level estimated crime counts

    get_estimated_arson()

    Get estimated arson data

    get_state_participation()

    Get state level UCR and NIBRS participation data

    get_region_participation()

    Get regional level UCR and NIBRS participation data

    get_agency_participation()

    Get agency level UCR and NIBRS participation data

    Arrest

    Functions for querying UCR arrest statistics

    get_arrest_count()

    Get arrest offense counts from the UCR Crime Data Explorer

    get_arrest_demographics()

    Get arrestee demographics from the UCR Crime Data Explorer

    get_arrest_demographics_all()

    Get arrestee demographics for all UCR arrest offenses

    list_ucr_arrest_offenses()

    Return a vector of all offenses in the UCR Arrest data.

    NIBRS

    Functions for querying National Incident-Based Reporting System data

    get_nibrs_victim()

    Gets victim-level data from the FBI's National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS)

    get_nibrs_offender()

    Gets offender-level data from the FBI's National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS)

    get_nibrs_offense()

    Gets offense-level data from the FBI's National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS)

    list_nibrs_offenses()

    Return a vector of all offenses in the NIBRS data.

    list_nibrs_victim_variables()

    Returns a vector of all `variable` parameter options for `get_nibrs_victim()`.

    list_nibrs_offender_variables()

    Returns a vector of all `variable` parameter options for `get_nibrs_offender()`.

    list_nibrs_offense_variables()

    Returns a vector of all `variable` parameter options for `get_nibrs_offense()`.

    list_regions()

    Return a vector of all regions choices.

    SHR

    Functions for querying Supplemental Homicide Reports data

    get_shr()

    Get Supplemental Homicide Reports (SHR) offense counts

    Police Employment

    Functions for querying police staffing data

    get_police_employment()

    Get agency-, state-, region-, or national-level police staffing data.

    Get the FBI CDE API base URL

    cde_query()

    flatten_cde_json()

    is_valid_state()

    Data

    Built-in reference data and datasets

    fbi_api_agencies

    All agencies included in the FBI's Crime Data Explorer API.

    nibrs_offenses

    All offenses available to get NIBRS data for.

    nibrs_victim_variables

    All available variables for NIBRS victim data.

    nibrs_offender_variables

    All available variables for NIBRS offender data.

    nibrs_offense_variables

    All available variables for NIBRS offense data.

    ucr_arrest_offenses

    All offenses available to get NIBRS data for.

    regions

    Regions available to get estimated UCR and NIBRS data for.

    API Key Management

    get_api_key()

    Returns the FBI's Crime Data Explorer API key

    set_api_key()
